title: DiscoveryPlanV1
description: A single version of a market-discovery plan. Describes HOW the system will search for advertising traction signals for a given creator capability — never a confirmed product, sale, or ROAS claim. This schema is intentionally flattened (no $ref/$defs) because n8n's Structured Output Parser node does not support $ref resolution. Keep it flat if you edit it.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only with a matching change here and in n8n prompts/workflows.

capabilityUnderstanding.description: The model's restated understanding of what the creator can produce, in its own words. Never a product recommendation — a reflection check so the user can confirm the model understood the brief.

language.description: Primary language for ad search, e.g. 'pl'.

notes.description: Free-text caveats about market scope, e.g. diaspora audiences, bilingual segments. Empty string if none.

seedQueries.description: Initial search probes to run against ad libraries/search engines. These are FIRST PROBES to explore, not confirmed product hypotheses.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'sq-1'. Must be unique within this plan.

query.description: The literal search string/phrase to try.

rationale.description: Why this probe was chosen, tied back to the stated capability.

enabled.description: Whether this query is currently active. Lets a user switch a query off without deleting it.

source.description: Where this query came from. DISCOVERY_EXPANSION is reserved for a future iterative-discovery loop and is not produced by MR-01/MR-02 yet.

candidateProductTypes.description: Plausible product/offer formats worth watching for, drawn from the creator's declared available formats. Not a recommendation to build any of them.

initialTaxonomy.description: A starter set of topic/segment categories to organize discovered signals under. Expected to evolve across plan revisions.

discoveryStrategies.description: Executable search strategies, each tied to a discovery capability the current collector runtime actually supports (see availableDiscoveryCapabilities in the MR-01 request). Describes HOW to search, not WHO was found — no results are collected yet at plan time. Do not propose a source/mode combination the runtime cannot execute.

source.description: Which discovery source this strategy runs against. Only sources the current collector implements are valid; extending this list requires a schemaVersion bump.

mode.description: Which mode of that source this strategy uses. Only modes the current collector implements are valid; extending this list requires a schemaVersion bump.

queryExpansionPolicy.description: Rules for how future discovery rounds should widen or narrow the taxonomy/seed queries as results come in.

whenToBroaden.description: Condition under which the next round should widen scope.

whenToNarrow.description: Condition under which the next round should narrow scope.

maxExpansionRounds.description: Suggested cap on automatic expansion rounds before requiring human review.

openUnknowns.description: Explicit list of things the plan does NOT know yet and should not guess at (e.g. exact audience age range, willingness to pay). Keeps the model honest about gaps.

constraints.description: Hard constraints carried over from the project brief that discovery must respect (e.g. exclusions, compliance limits).

discoveryLimits.description: Operational guardrails passed to the Playwright collector so a run cannot runaway. Modeled on what the collector actually iterates over (query -> ads via scrolling a results list), not on advertiser counts.

maxQueriesPerRun.description: Maximum number of enabled seedQueries the scheduler will run in a single DiscoveryRun.

maxAdsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of ads collected for any single query before moving on.

maxScrollsPerQuery.description: Hard cap on result-list scroll/pagination steps per query, independent of ad counting.

stopAfterScrollsWithoutNewAds.description: Stop scrolling a query early after this many consecutive scrolls that yielded no new ads.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Wall-clock cap for the whole DiscoveryRun.

saturationCriteria.description: Conditions under which a discovery round should be considered 'done for now' (diminishing returns), so the collector/human knows when to stop rather than searching indefinitely.

changeSummary.description: A short human-readable summary of what changed from the previous plan version and why. Required (schema-enforced) on every version: MR-01 (initial LLM generation) sets it to ""; MR-02 (LLM revision) sets a non-empty summary; a manual revision gets its changeSummary generated mechanically by the app from a structural diff against the parent version (never an LLM call), optionally with the user's own short note appended.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notices about the revision or generation, e.g. 'user instruction conflicted with declared constraint X and was only partially applied'. Required (schema-enforced); empty array if none.
